description: [PAID $0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Balances of one address on Base mainnet in a single call: native ETH, the well-known tokens USDC, USDT, USDbC, DAI, WETH, cbETH, wstETH, AERO (non-zero only, or all with includeZero=true), plus up to 10 extra ERC-20 contracts you pass in `tokens` (symbol/name/decimals read on-chain). Also nonce, account type (EOA, EIP-7702 delegated EOA, or contract) and a USD total for ETH/WETH (Chainlink) and stablecoins. Read live from public Base RPC via Multicall3; cached 10 s. All params optional: defaults to a well-known public address. Invalid input = 400, never charged.

address.description: Base address (0x + 40 hex). Optional: defaults to 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045 (vitalik.eth).

includeZero.description: Also list well-known tokens with zero balance (default false).

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated extra ERC-20 contract addresses on Base (max 10).

name: base_wallet_balances
title: Base wallet balances (ETH + tokens)
